note: Discovery order per tool: env var, PATH names, path hints, then a recursive name scan of the tool dirs (GTA_FORGE_TOOLS, %LOCALAPPDATA%\GTAForge\tools, and tool_dirs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\GTAForge\config.json). Personal paths belong in config.json, not here.
